author: Michael Larabel
description: AMD ROCm 10.2 is out today as the newest six-week feature release to this open-source AMD Radeon/Instinct GPU compute stack...
title: AMD ROCm 10.2 Released With Latest Optimizations, Expanded Ryzen Laptop Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those looking for a new laptop with Linux pre-loaded and have been eyeing the Intel Core Ultra Series 3 "Panther Lake" for its nice Xe3 Arc B390 graphics and overall power efficiency, Dell recently certified their XPS 14 (DA14260) laptop for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS Linux use. This latest Dell XPS 14 is well built and provides a nice and performant out-of-the-box Linux experience.
title: Dell XPS 14 DA14260 Powered By Intel Panther Lake Delivers Nice Linux Experience

author: Michael Larabel
description: The out-of-tree Multikernel Linux patches for allowing multiple independent kernel instances to run on the same physical machine is out with a new version...
title: Multikernel Linux Comes To ARM64, mklinux 7.0-mk5 Released

author: Michael Larabel
description: When it comes to leveraging AI for Linux kernel development, one of the most widely-used solutions at the moment is Sashiko that has evolved nicely over the past year for agentic AI code review. This AI-driven screening of generated code posted to the Linux kernel mailing list constantly identifies bugs and other code defects in a quick and straight-forward manner. With being developed and maintained by Google engineers, it uses Gemini by default but is LLM-agnostic overall. Released on Tuesday was Sashiko v0.9.4 as the next step forward for this Linux kernel helper...
title: AI-Powered Sashiko Introduces Experimental Patch Series Design Assessment

author: Michael Larabel
description: The PC Engines APU2 single board computer debuted all the way back in 2015 with the AMD Jaguar-powered GX-412TC quad-core SoC and 2~4GB of DDR3 memory. While PC Engines discontinued the APU2 SBC several years ago, these boards have been quite popular for networking/firewall applications and other similar low-power, networking-oriented setups. If you still happen to be using PC Engines APU2 hardware, 3mdeb today released updated system firmware for this decade old SBC...
title: 3mdeb Updates The Open-Source Firmware For Aging AMD Jaguar Powered PC Engines APU2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last week Qualcomm engineers published an initial draft of their new Ath12k WiFi driver and already a second version of this driver debuted today for addressing some issues raised by the early Sashiko-based AI review...
title: Qualcomm Ath12k Linux Driver Preparing For New WiFi 8 Hardware

author: Michael Larabel
description: Introduced in Linux 7.4 is a new driver for the Nintendo Switch 2 controllers that was developed by Valve. The widely-used SDL library used by games for software/hardware abstractions now has added mappings for this driver to ensure the Switch 2 controllers will jive nicely for Linux gaming...
title: SDL Ready For Linux's New Nintendo Switch 2 Controller Driver
